verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents its own off-ramp: a hosted widget and API/SDK rails in which users pick the crypto, fiat currency and amount, choose a payout method, and get paid to a bank account or Visa card, with sell-specific requote webhooks. The evidence describes a consumer-initiated sell flow rather than a stablecoin-to-bank payout rail for an ops team, and no published currency or country coverage appears. Missing for 10: published list of supported payout currencies and countries, explicit stablecoin-to-bank conversion and named local rails for off-ramp, business-initiated recipient payout flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
